mapper.select: SELECT ID,task_id,task_thread_desc,task_thread_cron,tesk_thread_sort FROM system_docking.api_task_thread_ins WHERE task_id=#{processId} AND is_enable='1' ORDER BY tesk_thread_sort

SELECT DISTINCT f.ID,f.system_code,f.system_name,f.system_desc FROM system_docking.api_task_ins a LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_task_thread_ins b on a.id=b.task_id and b.is_enable='1' LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_task_thread_index c on b.id=c.thread_id LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_platform_index_info d on c.index_id=d.id and d.is_enable='1' LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_interface_system_platform_info e on d.platform_id=e.id and e.is_enable='1' LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_interface_system_info f on e.system_id=f.id and f.is_enable='1' WHERE a.is_enable='1' AND (f.id IS NOT NULL OR f.id <> '' )
AND a.id=#{processId}
SELECT ID,system_id,platfrom_code,platfrom_name,platform_desc FROM system_docking.api_interface_system_platform_info WHERE system_id=#{systemId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,platform_id,index_code,index_name,index_desc FROM system_docking.api_platform_index_info WHERE platform_id=#{platformId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,platform_id,resource_code,resource_mac,resource_desc FROM system_docking.api_system_resource WHERE platform_id=#{platformId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,resource_id,ip_address FROM system_docking.api_system_resource_ip WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT * FROM ${params.dataBase}.api_system_records WHERE api_status <> '200' AND api_count < ${params.restartCount}

update.foreach: UPDATE ${params.dataBase}.api_system_records SET api_status=#{item.statusCode}, add_time=#{item.addTime}, api_count=(api_count + #{item.restartCount}) WHERE ID=#{item.ID}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM information_schema.TABLES t WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA =#{params.dataBase} and t.TABLE_NAME =#{params.tableName}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${params.dataBase}.${params.tableName} ( ID varchar(32) NOT NULL, system_id varchar(32), platform_id varchar(32), index_id varchar(32), resource_id varchar(32), resource_code varchar(500), resource_ip varchar(32), time varchar(32), content text, ADD_DATE varchar(20) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS upm.netperformanceeventlog_${params.tableMonth} ( id varchar(32) NOT NULL, category varchar(100), name varchar(500), lineId varchar(100), netsegmentId1 varchar(20), netsegmentId2 varchar(20), level varchar(10), time varchar(32), triggerCondition text, probeId varchar(40), ADD_DATE varchar(20), PRIMARY KEY (id) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS upm.alarmlogAbnormalbehavior_${params.tableMonth} ( id varchar(32) NOT NULL, category varchar(100), name varchar(500), clientIpAddr varchar(20), clientPort varchar(10), clientNetsegmentId varchar(20), serverIpAddr varchar(20), serverPort varchar(10), serverNetsegmentId varchar(20), ipAddr varchar(20), netsegmentId varchar(20), level varchar(10), time varchar(32), triggerCondition text, probeId varchar(40), ADD_DATE varchar(20), PRIMARY KEY (id) );
